newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher after Dow hits another peak.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher after Dow hits another peak.

text.p: UK shares forged ahead at the start of trade on Wednesday after expectations that Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan would try to deflate Wall Street's optimism proved unfounded as the Dow hit a new peak.
By 0836 GMT the FTSE 100 index was 20.7 points firmer at 4,216.2, within striking distance of Friday's record high of 4,218.4. March gilt futures were 10/32 higher at 111-06/32

"Greenspan's speech seems to have been taken very well and he didn't take the chance to knock Wall Street down to earth," one trader said. The Dow Jones industrial average closed up 40.03 points at 6,883.90, beating Monday's high of 6,843.87.
